events.text: Agvan Dorzhiev was born in Khara-Shibir ulus.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 1853 , Khara-Shibir ulus

events.text: Agvan Dorzhiev died in Ulan-Ude.
events.subject: self
events.quote: January 29 , 1938 , Ulan-Ude

events.text: He built the Buddhist temple of Saint Petersburg.
events.subject: self
events.quote: building the Buddhist temple of Saint Petersburg in 1909

events.text: He signed the Tibet-Mongolia Treaty.
events.subject: self
events.quote: signing the Tibet-Mongolia Treaty in 1913

events.text: He left home to study at the Gomang College of the Gelugpa Drepung monastic university.
events.subject: self
events.object: Gomang College of the Gelugpa Drepung monastic university
events.quote: He left home in 1873 at nineteen to study at the Gomang College

events.text: He attained the title of a Tsanit Khenpo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in the mid-1880s , after 15 years of study , he attained the title of a Tsanit Khenpo

events.text: He retained his role as one of the 13th Dalai Lama's teachers until at least the late 1910s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: retained this role until at least the late 1910s

events.text: The Tsar Nikolai II gave Agvan Dorzhiev a monogrammed watch.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1896 , the Tsar , Nikolai II , gave Agvan Dorzhiev a monogrammed watch

events.text: Dorzhiev went to Saint Petersburg to collect subscriptions for his monastic college.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In early 1898 Dorzhiev went to Saint Petersburg to collect subscriptions

events.text: Dorzhiev returned to Russia with six other representatives from Thubten Gyatso.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the spring of 1900 Dorzhiev returned to Russia with six other representatives

events.text: Agvan Dorzhiev visited Thubten Chökyi Nyima, the Ninth Panchen Lama.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1901 , Thubten Chökyi Nyima , the Ninth Panchen Lama ( 1883–1937 ) , was visited by Agvan Dorzhiev .

events.text: By 1903, Lord Curzon and Francis Younghusband became wrongly convinced that Russia and Tibet had signed secret treaties.
events.subject: other
events.quote: By 1903 , both Lord Curzon , the Viceroy of India , and Francis Younghusband became wrongly convinced that Russia and Tibet had signed secret treaties

events.text: The British expedition to Tibet took place during 1903–4.
events.subject: other
events.quote: a reason for the British expedition to Tibet during 1903–4

events.text: In early 1904 Dorzhiev convinced the Dalai Lama to flee to Urga in Mongolia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In early 1904 Dorzhiev convinced the Dalai Lama to flee to Urga in Mongolia

events.text: During the summer of 1912, he met the 13th Dalai Lama at Phari Dzong.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During the summer of 1912 , he met the 13th Dalai Lama at Phari Dzong

events.text: 1913 saw the great celebrations for the 300th anniversary of the House of Romanov.
events.subject: other
events.quote: 1913 saw the great celebrations for the 300th anniversary of the House of Romanov

events.text: Dorzhiev made speeches thanking the Tsar for his essential support for the Buddhist community in Saint Petersburg.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Dorzhiev made speeches thanking the Tsar for his essential support for the Buddhist community in Saint Petersburg

events.text: A lama named Ulyanov published a book that same year attempting to prove that the Romanovs were directly descended from Sucandra.
events.subject: other
events.quote: a book that same year attempting to prove that the Romanovs were directly descended from Sucandra

events.text: Dorzhiev got permission from the Tsar to build a large Buddhist datsan in Saint Petersburg.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1909 Dorzhiev got permission from the Tsar to build a large and substantial Buddhist datsan or temple in Saint Petersburg

events.text: Agvan Dorzhiev and two other Tibetan representatives signed a treaty in Urga.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In early 1913 , Agvan Dorzhiev and two other Tibetan representatives signed a treaty in Urga

events.text: The Mongolian Academy of Sciences published the Mongolian text of the treaty.
events.subject: other
events.quote: been published by the Mongolian Academy of Sciences in 1982

events.text: The Tibet-Mongolia Treaty was signed on 29 December 1912 (OS) by Dorzhiev and two Tibetans.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It was signed on 29 December 1912 ( OS )

events.text: The treaty was signed by Dorzhiev and two Tibetans, making it 8th January 1913 by the Gregorian Calendar.
events.subject: self
events.quote: thus making it 8th January 1913 by the Gregorian

events.text: Dorzhiev founded a manba datsan, a medical college, at the monastery of Atsagat.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Also in 1913 , Dorzhiev founded a manba datsan , a medical college , at the monastery of Atsagat

events.text: The Buddhist monasteries in Buryatia were nationalised.
events.subject: other
events.quote: In 1926 the Buddhist monasteries in Buryatia were nationalised

events.text: Dorzhiev led and managed a conference of Tibetan doctors in Atsagat.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In August 1927 , he led and managed a conference of Tibetan doctors in Atsagat

events.text: Dorzhiev was arrested by the NKVD during the Great Purge.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was again arrested by the NKVD during Joseph Stalins Great Purge on November 13 , 1937

events.text: Dorzhiev died in police custody after being transferred from his cell to the prison hospital.
events.subject: self
events.quote: after being transferred from his cell to the prison hospital on January 29 , 1938 , aged 85

events.text: Dorzhiev was officially fully rehabilitated when the case was dismissed.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until May 14, 1990, when the case was dismissed

dropped.text: The British expedition to Tibet ended in 1904.
dropped.subject: other
dropped.quote: a reason for the British expedition to Tibet during 1903–4
